title: Pan-STARRS discovers 'Oumuamua
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Pan-STARRS discovers 'Oumuamua, about 2017 at Pan-STARRS telescope, Hawaii; interstellar space, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In 2017, the Pan-STARRS telescope in Hawaii discovered a fast-traveling object in space called Oumuamua.
In 2017, we discovered Amua Mua, the first ever interstellar object to visit our solar system.
tellings.difference: Leaves out Pan-STARRS and Hawaii, and calls it the first interstellar object ever seen in the solar system.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the 2017 discovery of 'Oumuamua as the first interstellar object.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2017 a telescope in Hawaii called Pan-STARRS found a fast-moving object travelling through space, which was named Oumuamua. He tells it while introducing a Harvard scientist, Avi Loeb, as a starting point for the question of whether an object passing through from the space between the stars could be something more than a natural rock.
